fields.description: The Wilds Residences is Aldar’s apartment and duplex collection within The Wilds in Dubai. The February 2026 launch introduces 740 homes in six mid-rise buildings, with one to three bedroom apartments and two to three bedroom duplexes. It is a separate release from the community’s Cassia and Ravenna villas.

reviewCoverage.identity: Dedicated 2026 apartment release verified from Aldar announcement, landing and branded factsheet; villa and mansion phases excluded.
reviewCoverage.location: Official material places the community beside Majan and Al Barari. Existing Dubailand area mapping used, with the more detailed locality in the location note.
reviewCoverage.residences: One to three bedroom apartments and two/three bedroom duplexes confirmed; maid-room variants identified in branded plans.
reviewCoverage.areas: Five representative apartment/duplex designs visually reviewed. Drawings do not print aggregate areas, so the unit figures are attributed Bayut launch examples.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Residence-specific facilities separated from wider Wilds masterplan facilities and optional paid services.
reviewCoverage.pricing: Branded factsheet and Bayut agree on original AED 1.6m one-bedroom reference; no current available inventory inferred.
reviewCoverage.payment: Branded factsheet gives 65/35, supported by Bayut 5/60/35. Broker also lists a 50/50 alternative, so current terms require unit-specific confirmation.
reviewCoverage.handover: Branded project factsheet explicitly states Q2 2030, corroborated by Bayut. Villa 2029 delivery not transferred to apartments.
reviewCoverage.documents: Twenty-eight-page brochure, eight-page plan pack and one-page branded factsheet downloaded from public copies. Facts table and five complete apartment/duplex designs visually checked.

overview: The community arrangement connects the apartment buildings with landscape and outdoor routes. The wider Wilds setting includes a central park and The Nest pavilion, which provides spaces for learning, gathering and nature-related activities. The residence facilities add indoor social and creative spaces to that outdoor setting.
research.locationNote: The Wilds is beside Majan and Al Barari, with access from Sheikh Mohammed bin Zayed Road. Property portals refer to Wadi Al Safa 3. Dubailand is the existing catalogue area; the project is not in Dubai South despite some broad marketing descriptions of its position.
research.priceNote: The branded factsheet and Bayut record AED 1.6m for the original one-bedroom starting guide. Releases, selected layouts and resale offers carry different prices. Confirm a current itemized quotation before relying on this reference.
research.paymentNote: The original factsheet uses 65/35; Bayut breaks that into 5% booking, 60% construction and 35% handover. DXB Residence also lists a 10/40/50 alternative. The selected contract determines eligibility and dates; the historical launch schedule is not a new booking offer.
research.handoverNote: The Wilds Residences factsheet estimates Q2 2030, also reported by Bayut. This apartment schedule is separate from The Wilds villa phase. Confirm the selected building’s current handover programme with Aldar.
